public.text: Sex, gender, administrative territory, language, and relationship type are cited as coded attributes. These concepts are legally, socially, clinically, and culturally sensitive and may not be represented adequately by one national value set.
public.suggestedRevision: Require purpose-specific definitions, inclusive and jurisdictionally appropriate value sets, separation of concepts, versioning, and governance involving affected communities and domain experts.
